Subject: Clearsky Health: launch orchestration — owners, blockers, and intake packet

Hi Marissa & Vivek,

Quick handoff for Clearsky Health (deal RDW-2027-0451). They signed last week for a Dedicated pool (12-month commitment, estimated ARR $350k) with an initial pilot followed by a phased go-live. High level:

- Go-live target (full rollout): 2027-06-28
- Pilot window: 2027-06-10 to 2027-06-24
- Product footprint: text generation (chat) + embeddings for search; will start on hosted dedicated in us-east and then evaluate an EU replica for data residency in Q3.
- SLA/Compliance asks: standard SLA + request for SOC 2 evidence (they already received our SOC report in the NDA stage). They also flagged basic HIPAA controls for data handling.

Open blockers that I couldn't clear from sales:
1) Procurement still needs to sign SOW (attached: Clearsky_SOW_v3.pdf).
2) Network contact for VPC peering is pending (Emily, who should I be connecting you to on our side?).
3) Customer wants an initial model and cost profile for their expected 1M tokens/month workload during pilot.

Action items I want CS/Deploy to pick up:
- Marissa: lead the onboarding (kickoff, runbook, acceptance criteria).
- Vivek: validate capacity/instance sizing and note any provisioning lead times or special requirements.
- Tessa: post-sale project manager for the pilot schedule and run daily stand-ups during pilot (I included her on the thread).

I've attached the SOW and a preliminary launch checklist I used for similar health customers. Please confirm owners and we can propose a kickoff slot to Clearsky next week.

Attachments: [Attachment: Clearsky_SOW_v3.pdf (PDF, 180KB)], [Attachment: launch_checklist.xlsx (XLSX, 48KB)]

Thanks — Rafael

Thanks for the context — a few technical notes / requests from infra: 

1) Capacity recommendation: for the pilot volume you described (approx 1M tokens/month with chat + embeddings), plan for a Dedicated pool backed by 4x A100-equivalent GPUs (can scale-up to 8x for full roll out). Provisioning lead time for GPUs in us-east is ~5 business days after PO/SOW sign.

2) VPC peering: we'll need the network contact and a CIDR range to start the peering plan. Also confirm whether the customer wants inbound IP allowlisting or mTLS based connectivity.

3) Data residency: Rafael noted an EU replica later — if they want data-at-rest in-region we'll need to schedule the EU replica after pilot (Q3). For pilot, all data will remain in us-east.

4) Model versions: we'll provision Redwood-verified gpt-opti-1.1 for chat and rembed-small-v2 for embeddings initially. If Clearsky requests a trimmed quantized variant for cost, we'll propose that during the pilot.

I'll draft an internal provisioning checklist and share the exact infra ticket template by EOD 5/21. For blockers: procurement / signed SOW and network contact are the two gating items.

-Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni | Head of Deployments, Redwood Inference
